title: 皐月賞の後に・ジャンプ&キャッチ！

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yessss, I did it… I really did it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I was up against a pack of giants, but I opened up a gap between 'em 'n got through! Didja see dat, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Aaaargh, my legs!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha, nah, I'm not lookin' too good here… but I knew it was gonna be like this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I might be a runt, but this runt leapt up 'n nabbed a memento for the fam back home…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gripped between Tamamo Cross's hands is the prize she jumped up and seized—the Satsuki Sho crown.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So this is what the Classic Triple Crown's like, huh? Everyone was fightin' for their lives just to get a better position. My body feels like it's been put through the wringer…
choice_data_list: It looks like you weren't the only one who had it rough.
It looks like you weren't the only one who had it rough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, ya talkin' 'bout her?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Urk! Wheeze…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Can't say I'm surprised. In a race this major, standin' out works against ya…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They'll mark ya, then no matter where ya go, there they are. Still, haven't heard her complainin'…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's more to her than glitz 'n glam… That's for sure…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross approaches Gold City.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: City, you were great out there. That race really put us through the wringer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But that look tells me… you're not even thinkin' about backin' down. That glint in your eye… It's sparklin' brighter than your hair is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …That's right. People think I'm just some pretty face, but I'm more than that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And you're not just some runt. You may be short, but those guts of yours are on par with some of the biggest stars.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on winning the Satsuki Sho, Tamamo.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Heh, thanks. 'Preciate it. Y'know, there's more to us than meets the eye.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now I can't wait to race you again! Just thinkin' about competin' with another hot-blooded racer's got my blood boilin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two nod, their gazes meeting as they regard each other with fiery determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, in an amazing showcase of sheer power and determination, Tamamo Cross grasps the first crown of the Classic Triple Crown.
